transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
...I don't know. Just... I hardly eat right anymore. Some days it's just coffee. Maybe a piece of bread, if that. My pants are... they're just hanging loose on me now. That's about it.
Are you trying to lose weight?
No... I'm not trying to. Just... don't really care about food.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah... I guess. Just... most days I wake up and it's just... heavy. Like this empty feeling right here in my chest. Just feels like... ain't nothing good waiting for me anyway. So I just wanna keep my head down.
Have you had thoughts about wanting to die or kill yourself?
No... I ain't... I wouldn't do nothing like that. Just... I don't know. I'm just tired, is all.
Do you still enjoy eating foods you used to like?

Not really. Just eat 'cause I have to. It's... kinda like everything else, I guess. I used to like walking down by the lake, or... working on my little model kits. But now... I don't know. They just sit there. I look at 'em and it's like... like they belong to somebody else. Just don't care about none of it no more.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I don't know exactly... maybe... about five months now. Just... been hanging over me since then.
How have you been sleeping lately?

Not good. I just... I lie there for hours. Just staring at the wall. Or I'll fall asleep and then... wake up way before the sun's even up. Can't get back to sleep after that. And even when I do sleep, it don't matter. Still wake up feeling... worn out. Just tired.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah... I guess. Just... my mind won't stay on things. I try to look at bills, or... forms... and it just don't work. Even just... at the store. I'll just stand there staring at the soup. Can't even figure out which can to buy. Just... get stuck.
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself a lot lately?

Yeah... I guess. Just... keep thinking about how I lost that job. Now my folks gotta help me out... just makes me feel like I ain't no good. I just sit there and... replay every mistake I ever made. Like I just... ruined everything.
Did this start after you lost your job?

Well... not right away. Right after they let me go, I was... I don't know. Just going non-stop. Real driven. It was kind of scary, honestly... how fast I was going. But then it just... dropped. Been stuck down here like this for about a month now.
During that time when you were going non-stop, did you need much less sleep than usual?
Yeah... I guess so. Back then I was only sleeping... maybe two or three hours a night. But I'd still just... jump right up. Like I had a full night's rest.
During that time when you were going non-stop, did you feel unusually up or irritable?

Yeah, I guess... a bit of both. Right after they let me go, I just felt... I don't know, fired up. Like nothing could touch me. But... if anybody told me to just take a breath or slow down, I'd... I'd just snap at 'em. Real quick.
During that fired-up time, were you doing a lot more projects or activities than usual?
Yeah, I guess so. I was... making all these lists. Pricing out tools. Calling up old tenants I knew, trying to line up handyman jobs. Just... going at it all day. A lot more than I ever used to.
During that fired-up period, did it cause serious problems in your life?
Problems? ...Nah, I don't think so. I mean... like I said, I snapped at some people. But... I didn't get into any real trouble or nothing. I was just... trying to work.
During that fired-up time, did you feel unusually confident or powerful, like you could do things other people couldn’t?

I don't know about powerful. I just... I told people I was gonna build my own handyman business. Easy. Thought I could show that building they made a big mistake letting me go. Just... felt like I had it all figured out, I guess.
About how many days did that fired-up period last?
I don't really know. I wasn't... keeping track of the days. Just a while, I guess.
Do you think that fired-up period lasted four days or more?
...Maybe. I guess it could've been. Like I said, I wasn't really countin' the days. Just... yeah, probably around there somewhere. I ain't sure.
During that fired-up time, were you talking a lot more than usual?

...I didn't really notice. But my sister... she said I was. Told me I was talkin' so fast about prices and flyers and the tenants... said she could barely get a word in. I don't know. Just had a lot to figure out, I guess.
During that fired-up time, did you do anything unusually risky or out of character, like spending too much money?
...No. I don't think so. I ain't exactly got the money to be spendin' like that anyway. So... no. Didn't do nothin' like that.
During that fired-up time, did your thoughts feel like they were racing?

...Yeah, I guess. Just... a lot going on up there. Like, I'd be thinking about one job, and then... well, then it's another plan, and another. All at once, kind of. Couldn't really get it to stop, even if I wanted to. Just... full.
